# Extract typed ArkTS channel fields before serializing payloads

## Platform difference

A platform-channel argument container is not necessarily an ordinary JavaScript object with the JSON serialization behavior the application expects.

## Implementation

Gardendless replaces JSON.stringify of the raw call arguments with explicit call.argument field extraction into a typed session structure, including optional fields separately. Its neighboring fixes also replace unsupported file-writing shorthand with open/write/finally-close. NJU introduces typed form models for its parsed data.

## Applicability

Use the selected Flutter OH embedding's accessor contract and explicit payload schema. Preserve version and optional-field semantics across Dart/native boundaries.

These observations apply to the pinned project revisions below, studied on 2026-09-30 and backfilled on 2026-10-06. Unspecified SDK/device compatibility remains unknown; this is not a fresh upstream assessment.

## Pitfalls and limitations

An intermediate accessor fix may be superseded by a later one; the cited Gardendless typed extraction is the later correction. Type casts alone do not validate hostile or malformed values.

## Verification

Round-trip required/optional fields, arrays, nulls and invalid types across the real codec; verify cleanup and error replies when parsing or I/O fails.

Evidence tier: historical source/diff studies, with commit and path existence rechecked in local Git during this backfill. No application build, dependency resolution, signing, installation or device execution was performed. Proposed checks above are acceptance criteria, not completed tests.
